newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Receptive to St Barbara bid - Leyshon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Receptive to St Barbara bid - Leyshon.

text.p: Mt Leyshon Gold Mines Ltd said on Wednesday it was receptive to the proposed merger offer from St Barbara Mines Ltd but was awaiting details in the formal Part A offer statement.

Mt Leyshon executive chairman Tony Palmer, who is also managing director of Leyshon's majority shareholder Normandy Mining Ltd, told Reuters it was obvious that the Mt Leyshon gold mine in Queensland had a limited mine life.
"So to that extent, this is an opportunity for Mt Leyshon to consider," he said.
